title: ESCAPING THE STATE OF NATURE: A HOBBESIAN APPROACH TO COOPERATION IN MULTI-AGENT REINFORCEMENT LEARNING
reasoning: The thesis applies Thomas Hobbes's moral and political philosophy (specifically concepts like moral subjectivism and the state of nature) to the design and evaluation of artificial agents. It introduces the 'Civilization Game' as a way to experimentally test and benchmark agents' ability to achieve cooperation based on these philosophical frameworks.
